recipe.title: Ginger crinkle biscuits
recipe.notes: This recipe is from Sugar & Spice by Jo Seagar. Dairy and soy-free.

method.s: Beat oil, sugar, egg and treacle together.
Stir in flour, baking soda and spices, and mix well.
Drop teaspoonfuls into the sugar and form balls (they will flatten by themselves).
Place on an ungreased baking tray 5 cm apart.
Bake for 10-15 minutes, then carefully remove to cool on a wire rack and store in an airtight container.
